CivBonuses.Name: Curadmír (The Hero's Portion)
CivBonuses.History: At the feast the best cut of the pig went to the greatest warrior, and heroes fought for the honour.
CivBonuses.Description: Heroes +0.5% attack for each enemy unit they kill, up to 40 kills (+20%).

CivBonuses.Name: Crech (Cattle Raids)
CivBonuses.History: Wealth and status in Ériu were counted in cattle, won and lost in endless raids.
CivBonuses.Description: Each head of cattle you own yields 1 metal per minute, up to 50 heads.

CivBonuses.Name: Karpaton (War Chariots)
CivBonuses.History: Irish heroes rode to battle in chariots and leapt down to fight on foot.
CivBonuses.Description: War chariots carry up to 3 infantry, which can dismount at any time.

CivBonuses.Name: Deas Celtica
CivBonuses.History: The druids, keepers of law, lore and sacrifice, stood beside the warriors of Ériu.
CivBonuses.Description: Druids increase attack rates of soldiers near them by 5%.
